mentions.name: polystore
mentions.description: This JavaScript library provides a widely compatible key-value store interface that connects to many stores, so a single library can make a wide range of stores easily accessible. It lets an API client library accept multiple cache stores without writing the compatibility layer itself, and lets a project use file-based storage for local dev (highly debuggable) and switch to Redis in production via a simple environment variable change.
mentions.problem: When building API client libraries or projects with caching, developers repeatedly have to write compatibility layers for multiple cache stores themselves; polystore aims to have a single library handle all of this.
mentions.audience: Developers building libraries and projects that need to support multiple cache/key-value stores across local development and production environments.
